text: The following question stood in the name of Ms Mariam Jaafar – 7 To ask the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) what is the amount of deposits collected under the Beverage Container Return Scheme from beverage producers and retailers since the commencement of the Scheme; (b) what is the amount refunded to consumers who returned containers over this period; and (c) how any surplus is accounted for and whether it is retained by BCRS Ltd, reinvested into scheme operations, or returned to Government.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: While the scheme remains in its transition phase until 30 September 2026, we have seen encouraging progress in the first three months.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: We expect this number to grow as more BCRS-labelled products enter the market.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Most transactions and returns at Reverse Vending Machines (RVMs) have been successful.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: For the handful of issues that occurred at the RVMs, the scheme operator BCRS Ltd worked closely with the RVM operators to respond quickly to resolve them.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: On scheme finances, BCRS Ltd is a not-for-profit company funded through the producer fees as well as revenue from the sale of recyclables collected.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: This is a common model adopted in other jurisdictions with similar deposit return schemes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The consumer pricing of beverages is a commercial decision that is influenced by multiple factors, including fuel and logistics costs, consumer demand patterns as well as producer or retailer marketing strategies.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Market players who raise the prices of their beverages will face direct competition with other industry players given the wide variety of beverage choices.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Nevertheless, members of the public who notice improper practices among retailers may alert NEA.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Many coffee shops are located within HDB estates and would have convenient access to an RVM.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: We thank all members of the public for their feedback, support and patience in adapting to this new mode of clean stream recycling as we continue to refine the scheme.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: We encourage everyone to participate actively by being mindful of the beverage containers you consume and returning empty beverage containers at designated return points.

speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: I want to thank NEA for the roll-out.

speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: I saw the officers on the ground helping residents grapple with the machines.

speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: I have got some feedback from residents that there continue as we roll out this programme, some eateries where the RVMs are not located nearby and they said that they feel that the cost is still being passed on to them.

speaker: Dr Hamid Razak (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: So, would the Ministry be able to provide some guidance where the merchants are able to then do the Return Right, therefore not passing on the cost to the residents in such eateries?
